verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm offering legal services such as venture, IP, employment and privacy counsel. Self-service export of user data in open formats is a software-platform axis, not something buyers comparing law firms would reasonably evaluate. The Clerky partnership mentions formation workflows but nothing about data export, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
